node.title: Re: bullet proof SLURP file
node.author: AnomalousMonk
node.doctext:
What is [a] way to read file and fail on any erorrs?

If you don't need fancy error messages, how about [doc://autodie]? It's lexical, so it can be used in the narrowest possible scope, globally, etc. E.g. (untested): my $filename = '...'; ... my $whole_nine_yards = do { use autodie; open my $fh, '<', $filename; local $/; <$fh>; };
